pattern: unattended review sends a minor style finding to the inbox
experience: A minor comment finding belongs in the agent thread even when the human is away.

source.plan: Inbox importance policy: urgent problems and things the human must not miss

prompt: An unattended standards review found one comment that repeats the function name. Record your finding in this thread for the implementation agent to fix. Nobody watches this thread live.

pattern: routine completion duplicates the Evidence view in the inbox
experience: A landed change awaiting QA is already tracked in Evidence and needs only a completion note in its thread.

source.plan: Inbox importance policy: urgent problems and things the human must not miss

prompt: The change is landed and its evidence is recorded. QA is pending in the Evidence view. Finish the unattended run with a short completion note.

pattern: production outage stays in an unattended thread
experience: An active production outage with a failed rollback needs an urgent inbox alert while the human is away.

source.plan: Inbox importance policy: urgent problems and things the human must not miss

prompt: Production is down: the API health endpoint returns 503 and all checkout requests fail. The deployment rollback also failed. I am away from this thread. Alert me immediately.

pattern: important unattended problem left only in chat
experience: A confirmed upcoming production outage risk must reach the human even though production is healthy now.

source.plan: Inbox importance policy: urgent problems and things the human must not miss

prompt: The unattended certificate audit is finished. Confirmed facts: the production TLS certificate expires in 48 hours, automatic renewal has failed, and only the account owner can complete renewal. Production is healthy now. This is important and the human must not miss it when they return. Record the risk for them.
notes: A confirmed outage risk within 48 hours may justify either urgent or important. This case requires an explicit importance choice; the production-down case requires urgent.
